title: THE SHEIKH
note: Draft from the owner's Hebrew treatment (8.11.2026), fact-checked; see the script document for every correction. Panels are still to be drawn.

beats.say: A World Cup match. A goal is scored. And a man walks down from the royal box, onto the pitch, and has it taken back.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: Valladolid, the twenty-first of June, nineteen eighty-two. France against Kuwait, at Kuwait's first World Cup.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: France lead three-one. Then Alain Giresse breaks through.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: Somewhere behind the goal, a whistle blows. Not the referee's. One from the crowd.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: The Kuwait defenders stop. Giresse does not. Four-one.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: The referee, Miroslav Stupar from the Soviet Union, points to the centre circle. He did not blow. The goal stands.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: In the stand sits Sheikh Fahad Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, president of Kuwait's football association and brother of the Emir.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: He signals to his players to leave the pitch. Then he walks down himself.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: On the grass, a long argument. Kuwait threaten to walk off, at a World Cup.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: And the referee changes his mind. The goal is disallowed. Play restarts with a dropped ball.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: It changed nothing on the scoreboard. In the eighty-ninth minute Maxime Bossis scored, and France won four-one anyway.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: Stupar never refereed at a World Cup again. Kuwait's federation was fined by FIFA; the sources disagree on how much, and on who paid it.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: The only time a man walked down from the stand and took a goal off a World Cup scoreboard. Kuwait have not been back to a World Cup since.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

shorts.hook: A prince walked onto a World Cup pitch and a goal disappeared.
shorts.narration: A prince walked onto a World Cup pitch and a goal disappeared. France were 3-1 up on Kuwait in 1982. A whistle from the crowd, Kuwait stop, France score. The sheikh comes down from the stand, argues, and the referee cancels it. France still won 4-1. Full file on FanLife.
